test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'were'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb required to fill the blank needs to be in the past tense form to match with the past tense '**said**' later in the sentence.
 
• The correct past tense form of '**be**' to be used for '**all the children**' is '**were**', making it the correct option.
 
• The rest of the options (be, was, will) are either in a different tense or not grammatically correct when linked with '**all the children**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The verb 'be' has several irregular forms including 'am', 'is', 'are' in the present tense and 'was', 'were' in the past.
